schema_note: Each entry follows docs/mvp/templates/skill-authoring/trigger-queries.json (id, query, should_trigger, split) plus a category field. Tier A only: these observe whether the terminal consults the skill for a request that does not name it. No entry supplies the skill path or name except the explicit_invocation category, which is recorded separately and is never counted as implicit activation evidence.
split_policy: Fixed and stratified by should_trigger and category, assigned once at authoring time and recorded here. It is not re-randomised per run. Validation entries and their should_trigger values must not be placed in an author-loop or task-worker context; only the train split may drive any description iteration.
negative_note: Every negative names the sibling that owns the request, so a near miss can be graded as correct routing rather than as mere non-activation. Several of those siblings are specified but not implemented, which does not weaken the negative: non-activation is observable without installing a routing target, and no stub may be installed to obtain a routing result.

owner_map.negative_new_release: devforge-change (SKILL-012; a new release or an advisory is a proposal, never authorisation to change an approved stack)
owner_map.negative_copy_edit: no skill; an isolated wording fix is ordinary work and acquires no architecture process
